How IDIU buys for its projects, and what this system keeps track of.
International Development Institute Uganda (IDIU) is a Christian non-profit based in Jinja, working with Korea Food for the
Hungry International (KFHI) and donors such as KOICA. Its projects reach communities in six districts:
Each project's budget, line by line; a purchase must fit an active line.

Register as a supplier, choose your categories and upload the documents each one needs. IDIU Procurement checks
them, may visit your premises, and recommends; the Country Director decides. You get an email either way, and
your account shows where your application is.
